verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an official Wizard CLI. It runs from a single terminal command to detect the framework, install the SDK, add the API key, fire a test event and produce a first dashboard. Its documented scope is limited to onboarding and instrumentation, not ongoing CLI management of the product. Missing for 10: a general-purpose CLI for querying data or managing flags, cohorts and dashboards; CLI reference docs; any AI-agent-oriented CLI features; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Run the Wizard CLI to instrument your codebase and get a first dashboard from one terminal command.
The wizard detects your framework, installs the right SDK, adds your API key, and fires a test event.
